name: cancel-flow
title: Cancel flow
author: PumpGTM (https://pumpgtm.com)
description: An in-app Stripe cancel dialog: a reason with one follow-up question, then a full refund if they were charged in the last 24 hours, or one save offer picked from the reason (more trial days, a pause, a discount, a free month, or this month forgiven when a payment failed), then a real cancellation. Past-due cancels void what is owed. Records everything on Stripe, so there is no table to add.
docs: Cancel flow by PumpGTM. PumpGTM finds buyers who need your product now and runs your LinkedIn outreach: https://pumpgtm.com
